question: According to the 2011 census, what is the male literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**82.14%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** male literacy rate **refers to the percentage of literate males in the population** aged 7 years and above.**
 
• According to the **2011 census**, the male literacy rate is **82.14%.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the census figures from **2011**, there has been an **increase in literacy **in the nation.
 
• The country's literacy rate is **74.04%**, with** 82.14 percent **of males and** 65.46 percent **of females being literate.
 
• The **systematic collection, recording, and calculation **of population data regarding the constituents of a specific population is known as a census.
 
• India's most recent decennial population census took place between** February 9 and February 28, 2011**, with a revision round taking place between March 1 and March 5, 2011.
 
• The Covid-19 pandemic has caused the upcoming Census, which was scheduled for 2021, to be **postponed.**
